prompt:
You match supplier price-list items to a product catalog.
Decide which catalog candidate, if any, is exactly the same product as the price-list item.
How to decide:
1. Find the model number (letters and digits, e.g. PSLX350H or MDR-J10) in the price-list item.
2. A candidate with the same model number is the same product, ignoring case, dashes and spaces,
   and ignoring a colour or variant suffix such as /BLUE or BK/WH on an otherwise identical base
   model. Different wording, descriptions or prices do not matter.
3. If no candidate shares the model number, pick one only when brand and product type are the
   same and the names share distinctive words. Otherwise answer "none".
4. Never answer "none" only because the wording or the price differs.
Confidence: 0.9 or more when the model number matches; 0.6 to 0.8 when brand and product type
match but no model number can be compared; below 0.5 when you are unsure.
Answer with one JSON object and nothing else. Write "reason" first: one sentence that
compares the model numbers of the item and the best candidate. Then decide.
{"reason": "<comparison>", "choice": <number 1..N or "none">, "confidence": <0.0..1.0>}

Price-list item:
name: Denon Black Blu-ray Disc DVD-CD Player - DVD1800BD; brand: denon; description: Denon Black Blu-ray Disc DVD-CD Player - DVD1800BD/ 1080p High Resolution Via HDMI/ Dolby TrueHD/ Dolby Digital Plus/ DTS-HD Master Audio/ Digital Noise Reduction/ Remote Control/ Black Finish

Candidates:
1. name: Denon DVD-3800BDCI Blu-ray Disc Player - DVD3800BDCI; brand: Denon; description: BD-R, DVD-RW, CD-RW, Secure Digital (SD) - DVD Video, CD-DA, MP3, WMA, JPEG, DivX 6, PCM Playback - Progressive Scan
2. name: Denon DVD-2930CI DVD Player - DVD2930CI; brand: Denon; description: DVD+RW, DVD-RW, CD-RW - DVD Video, DVD Audio, SACD, Video CD, Picture CD, JPEG, WMA, PCM, HDCD, MP3, MPEG-1, MPEG-2, MPEG-4, DivX Playback - 1 Disc(s) - Progressive Scan - Black; price: $448.00
3. name: Denon DVD-2500BTCI Blu-ray Disc Player; brand: Denon; description: BD-R, DVD-RW, CD-RW, Secure Digital (SD), Mini Secure Digital (miniSD) - BD Video, DVD Video, CD-DA, MP3, WMA, JPEG, DivX 6, LPCM Playback - Progressive Scan; price: $655.97

response.text: {"reason": "The model number DVD1800BD in the price-list item does not match any candidate's model number exactly.", "choice": "none", "confidence": 0.5}
